description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getUserCosts and getUserProjectsCosts, which perform aggregation queries on a MongoDB collection related to user costs, including breakdowns by agent and type, and grouping by project. It exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getUserCosts
methods.description: Aggregates total cost for a user with breakdowns by agent and type, normalizing schema aliases and handling nulls.

methods.name: getUserProjectsCosts
methods.description: Aggregates costs for a user grouped by project, including agent subtotals.
